mapper.select: SELECT sys01_company_id AS companyId , sys01_icam_company_cd AS icamCompanyCode FROM sys01_company WHERE CAST(sys01_company_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE #{companyId} AND sys01_icam_company_cd IS NOT NULL AND sys01_use_yn = 'true' AND sys01_erp_product_cd IN ('S3','A1') ORDER BY sys01_company_id
